tagline: 理光取景器相机，1980 年发布
description: 理光于1980年推出的取景器相机。配备Color-Rikenon 2.8/40, 4 elements in 3 groups。感光度25 to 800。0.9 m。

specs.曝光测光: shutter priority AE when f-stop ring set to "A"
specs.英文简介: In 1980 Ricoh presented four new models of the popular "500" compact camera series for 35mm film at the Photokina in Cologne: The 500 ST and the 500 ZF, both viewfinder, the latter one without self-timer.
